acceptance: The contract places Code inside the existing Knowledge workspace and Lens shell; no new top-level application, duplicate navigation or CBM iframe is permitted.
Symbol Graph, Import Graph and Call Graph plus Overview, Impact, Dependencies, Timeline, Trace and Code Planet are named without collapsing topology, semantic proximity or runtime trace truth.
Every visible mode names its source, version/generation, locator, confidence and clipping/freshness semantics.
Desktop, mobile, keyboard, reduced-motion, loading, empty, error, disabled, stale, partial and clipped states are explicit and testable.
The contract consumes only bounded CBM-08 projection capabilities; it cannot control the engine, index a repository, expose raw IDs or request an unbounded graph.
No renderer, route, productive graph, source access, provider, network, stage, commit, push, deploy or live action is added by the writer.
